slides.title: Clustering
slides.content:
# Clustering 🍇

Grouping similar data points together. No labels provided.

## K-Means Clustering
Most popular algorithm.
1. Choose `K` (number of groups).
2. Randomly place `K` centroids.
3. Assign each point to nearest centroid.
4. Move centroid to the average of its points.
5. Repeat until centroids stop moving.

## Hierarchical Clustering
Builds a tree of clusters (Dendrogram). Good for visualizing hierarchy.

## DBSCAN
Density-based. Can find weird shapes and ignores noise (outliers).

slides.title: Dimensionality Reduction
slides.content:
# Dimensionality Reduction 📉

What if you have 1000 features? The "Curse of Dimensionality" makes models slow and inaccurate. reducing columns helps.

## PCA (Principal Component Analysis)
Projects data onto new axes (Principal Components) that capture the most variance. You reduce 1000 columns to 50, but keep 95% of information!

## t-SNE
Mainly used for **visualization**. Compresses high-dimensional data into 2D or 3D plots so humans can see clusters.

slides.title: Anomaly Detection
slides.content:
# Anomaly Detection 🚨

Identifying rare items that differ significantly from the majority.

## Use Cases
- **Fraud Detection**: Credit card transactions.
- **IT Security**: Detecting intrusions.
- **Manufacturing**: Finding defective parts.

## Techiques
- **Isolation Forest**: Isolates anomalies by randomly splitting data. Anomalies are easier to isolate (shorter path in tree).
- **One-Class SVM**: Learns the boundary of "normal" data.
